title: Google's AI is leaving one line out of your answer
description:
Google's AI summaries quietly drop lines from their own sources, sometimes the one line that changes the answer. Here's the line most people read right past, and why it matters more than hallucination. Watch the full breakdown. Link in the pinned comment.
Topics: Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, AI search, Google I/O 2026.
#Shorts #GoogleAI #AIOverviews #AISearch #AIliteracy`
